setting: family living room at night with an old album; memories shown as living flashback vignettes, not framed memorial photographs

sentences.english: One night, I opened an old family album.
sentences.japanese: ある夜、古い家族アルバムを開きました。

sentences.english: Many familiar pictures appeared one by one.
sentences.japanese: 見覚えのある写真が、一枚ずつ現れてきます。

sentences.english: In the center of a picture, there is a girl playing the piano.
sentences.japanese: 真ん中の写真には、ピアノを弾いている女の子がいます。

sentences.english: It is my sister when she was small.
“Is that girl playing the piano really me?” she laughed.
sentences.japanese: 「ピアノを弾いてるこの子、ほんとにわたし?」と妹は笑いました。

sentences.english: There is also a boy running on a wide field.
sentences.japanese: 広い野原を走っている男の子の写真もありました。

sentences.english: That is my brother a few years ago.
My brother running with such energy looks much smaller than now.
sentences.japanese: そんなふうに元気に走っている兄は、今よりずっと小さく見えます。

sentences.english: “This is a letter written by your grandfather,” my mother told me.
sentences.japanese: 「これは、あなたのおじいちゃんが書いた手紙なのよ」と母が教えてくれました。

sentences.english: The letter is old, but the color of the ink is still clear.
sentences.japanese: 古い手紙だけど、インクの色はまだしっかり残っています。

sentences.english: At the entrance, there is a picture painted by an old friend.
sentences.japanese: 玄関には、母の古い友人が描いてくれた絵が飾られています。

sentences.english: Its soft colors warm my heart each time I see it.
sentences.japanese: やわらかな色合いが、見るたびに心を温かくしてくれます。

sentences.english: The boy laughing in the park with a balloon in his hand is Tom.
sentences.japanese: 公園で手に風船を持って笑っている男の子は、トムです。

sentences.english: His bright eyes have not changed at all.
sentences.japanese: あの明るい目は、今も少しも変わっていません。

sentences.english: Each picture holds a quiet story inside.
sentences.japanese: 一枚一枚の写真の中に、静かな物語がひそんでいます。
